method: Illustrative offline planning defaults assembled for Umbra, not direct record-by-record extracts or local agronomic predictions. Rounded kcal/kg refer to edible food mass; dry grains and pulses use dry edible mass. Yields, days, labour, feed and growing conditions vary by cultivar, weather and management. Replace defaults with local observations and extension advice. Plant spacing and animal housing values are editable planning starts, not universal requirements. Daily and weekly outputs are annual averages; seasonal harvests and meat cycles do not arrive evenly.
